title: at build-open, sail judges a decisions plan into outcomes and constraints, checks it coheres, and writes it through the cast door's admission
intention: When a ticket is opened for build (sail step 0a), a plan still in the decisions shape, or carrying an outcome with no claim, is judged before charting: each decision becomes an outcome with a claim or a constraint (a how Akien stated stays a constraint, verbatim), old clause n stays outcome n, a coherence check follows (every step reads as current; a conflict moves to the log or is named), and the converted plan is written only if the cast door's shape check admits it.
why: Measured 2026-11-14: Q#100 is answered and the plan becomes outcomes (outline 9.3.5.1.2.1); this component reads ticket plans, so by RULE 1 its dual-read is its own ticket, a sibling of aa3e9a70db47 (the migration).
traces_to: Law 5 (the plan carries what a builder needs now), RULE 1 (each reader changes inside its own component); outline 9.3.5.1.2.1.
how: Dual-read during the change: compose base's published plan view (5c1e0a7d93b2); after: 5c1e0a7d93b2.

clauses.claim: a decisions ticket and a migrated ticket with no-claim outcomes, given a packet judging every line, end with every outcome claimed, clause n still outcome n, each constraint's text verbatim in `constraints`, each 'log' conflict verbatim in the log, and the plan admitted by the cast door's shape check
a packet that leaves a line unjudged, or whose result the shape check refuses, writes nothing and names each lack

decisions.text: D1: skills/sail/judge_plan.py applies a judgement packet {n: {claim} | {constraint}, conflicts: [{n, disposition: log|named, why}]} to the ticket: an outcome n gets its claim, a constraint leaves the outcomes into `constraints` verbatim, outcome numbers are kept (no renumbering, so clause n stays n), a conflict marked log moves whole to the log via ticket_log.append_log and one marked named stays and is reported. It refuses a packet that leaves any decision or no-claim outcome unjudged, and writes through rewrite_ticket only when transitions._shape_lacks admits the result; else it writes nothing and names each lack. SKILL.md step 0a runs it before /chart when plan.awaiting(ticket) is non-empty or the plan carries decisions. It composes cairn.tools.base.plan (ticket 5c1e0a7d93b2): clauses(doc) gives [{n, claim}] from outcomes that carry a claim, else falsifier.clauses; steps(doc) gives [{n, text, writes_to, reads, after}] from outcomes (text = claim, else the migrated text), else decisions; it keeps no second reading of either shape.
D2: the red-first proof feeds the reader one ticket in each shape carrying the same content, one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: Akien answered Q#100 (open-7aee6f89e4d9, open-82f27105184f): "rather than tasks should we be focused on outcomes?" ... "yes, we're in agreement. signed -amm". Outline 9.3.5.1.2.1: a plan is constraints, then outcomes {n, claim, writes_to, reads, after, via?}, then resources; the falsifier's clauses merge into the outcomes (old clause n stays outcome n); during the change every reader accepts both shapes, one sibling ticket per reader component.
measured.how: his answer, relayed verbatim by orchestrator; recorded at the question door; outline 9.3.5.1.2.1
